tools.name: Actelo
tools.positioning: Financing software for French IOBSP credit brokers, covering the calculation, document and invoicing side of a mortgage file.
tools.description: Actelo is a French SaaS platform for IOBSP credit brokers. It covers the financing side of a mortgage file end to end: eligibility and amortisation calculations, borrower insurance quoting, generation of the regulatory financing documents, a document management space, a borrower portal, invoicing of the parties involved and activity statistics. It is sold per user with a published monthly price and no commitment.
tools.real_estate_use: A mortgage broker takes in a buyer whose offer has just been accepted and has to turn a project into a bankable file within days. Actelo runs the calculation side: it works out which loan structures the project is eligible for, prices the borrower insurance, lists the supporting documents to collect, and produces the financing proposal and the regulatory paperwork. The borrower drops the documents in their own space instead of emailing them, and the broker follows the file stage by stage until the invoicing of the commission. Independent brokers and franchise networks use it as their whole back office rather than as an add-on to a CRM.
features: Automated financing calculations and loan structuring
Borrower insurance pricing and one-click quote

Document management and borrower self-service portal

tools.name: Eloa
tools.positioning: French origination platform for credit intermediaries: simulate a mortgage, assemble the borrower file, apply each bank convention, invoice the commission.
tools.description: Eloa publishes eCredits, a configurable platform for regulated credit intermediaries in France, alongside eImmo for rental and renovation financing and eMobilite for vehicle dealers. eCredits covers mortgage, consumer, professional and debt consolidation lending. Its calculation engine produces amortising, zero-interest, interest-only, bridge, stepped and smoothed loan scenarios, and applies the rate grids and document requirements the broker has configured for each partner bank. It also handles commission, invoicing and activity reporting, and offers a broker website module. The editor states more than 20,000 professionals use it.
tools.real_estate_use: A French mortgage broker is an IOBSP: the file it assembles has to satisfy both the borrower and a bank whose rate grid, document list and commission terms differ from every other bank's. Eloa is where that file lives from the first simulation to the accepted offer. The broker qualifies affordability with the simulators, which create the case and carry the data forward instead of being re-keyed, then compares scenarios across the banks configured in its own conventions. Because commissioning and invoicing sit in the same tool, a network can see per-branch and per-broker production without exporting anything. Agencies and developers meet it from the other side, as the financing partner's system that tells them whether a buyer is financeable.

tools.name: Knock CRM
tools.positioning: Front-office leasing platform for multifamily: self-scheduled tours, unified prospect messaging, source attribution and team performance oversight.
tools.description: Knock CRM is a leasing customer-relationship platform for multifamily owners and operators, now published by RealPage. It groups tour scheduling, marketing attribution, prospect messaging, task management, visitor experience and team oversight into one front-office suite. Knock Now lets a prospective renter self-schedule a tour from any website or app. Messaging brings email, text, voice and chat into a single screen. Source attribution ties each lead back to the marketing channel that produced it and drives automated campaigns. Benchmarking and performance trends give leasing leadership visibility into individual and team activity. The vendor also offers AI solutions, advanced analytics and a data cloud with API access alongside the core CRM.
tools.real_estate_use: A leasing team at a large apartment community loses prospects between the first inquiry and the tour. With Knock the renter books their own slot straight from the property website, so nobody waits for a callback, and every subsequent exchange — text, email, call, chat — lands in one inbox where any agent on shift can pick it up. The regional marketer looks at source attribution to see which portal or campaign is actually filling the calendar and cuts the ones that are not. The leasing director uses the benchmarking view to compare conversion across communities and to see which agents let follow-ups lapse.

tools.name: LeadSimple
tools.positioning: CRM, shared inbox, phone system and process automation that sit on top of a property management system.
tools.description: LeadSimple is a communication and workflow layer for residential property management companies. It combines an owner and tenant CRM, a shared inbox unifying calls, texts and email on one timeline, a phone system with ring groups and an AI voice agent, recurring process workflows with branching logic and escalation, and maintenance work orders. It does not replace the PMS: it connects to AppFolio, Buildium, Rentvine, Propertyware and Rent Manager. Pricing is published, per seat for the inbox and CRM products and per door for workflows.
tools.real_estate_use: A property management company growing past a few hundred doors finds that the accounting system holds the ledgers but nothing holds the conversation: a tenant voicemail about a water heater, an owner question about a statement, a Zillow enquiry all live in different inboxes and in one person's head. LeadSimple gives every call, text and email an owner and a next step on one timeline, and turns the repeatable sequences — move-in, renewal, inspection, owner onboarding, make-ready — into timed workflows with escalation when a step slips. It is bought by companies that already have a PMS and are losing leads and owner trust in the handoffs around it.

Recurring process workflows with branching logic and PMS-triggered starts

tools.name: Maline
tools.positioning: Predictive seller prospecting for French agencies: owners likely to sell are identified from life events and delivered on an exclusive territory.
tools.description: Maline Immobilier is a French service that identifies owners likely to put a property up for sale several months ahead, and delivers them to an agency as qualified seller leads. Its stated method is the analysis of life events — divorce, marriage, birth, retirement, professional relocation, inheritance — which the vendor says account for the great majority of sales, combined with dozens of qualification criteria. Prospecting zones are sold as exclusive territories: once an agency reserves an area, no other Maline subscriber prospects it, and the number of leads follows the number of dwellings in the zone. The vendor states first contacts arrive around fifteen days after a territory is activated.
tools.real_estate_use: French agencies have prospected for decades by pige, that is by working the for-sale-by-owner ads, and the vendor positions itself squarely against the disappearance of that practice. The alternative it proposes is to arrive before the ad exists: to knock on the door of an owner whose circumstances suggest a sale within a year, when there is still a mandate to win rather than a price war to lose. The exclusive territory is what an agency is really buying, since a predictive lead shared with three competitors is worth nothing. It is a fit for an agency with the discipline to work a farm patiently over months, and a poor fit for one that needs listings this quarter.
features: Detection of likely sellers from life events several months before listing
Qualification of owners against dozens of criteria
Exclusive prospecting territory per subscriber
Lead volume scaled to the number of dwellings in the zone
Automatic delivery of qualified seller contacts

use_cases.job: Win a mandate by reaching an owner before the property is advertised

tools.name: Pilotim
tools.positioning: Full-web software for French estate agencies, pairing property and client management with an AI assistant built into the daily workflow.
tools.description: Pilotim is a French web-based estate agency software covering property and contact management, matching of buyers against listings, communication material, templated emails and activity history. It embeds an AI assistant, marketed as IA Pilotim, which drafts or rewrites listing copy from the property's attributes, turns an agent's notes into a visit report for the owner, writes SEO articles for the agency blog, restyles or virtually furnishes interior photos and returns before-and-after images, answers questions asked in plain language over the agency's own listings, estimates, contacts and statistics, and creates a property from dictation on mobile. tools.real_estate_use: An independent French agency runs its day inside Pilotim: entering a mandate, matching it against the buyer base, publishing it, and keeping the record of what was said and when. The AI is aimed squarely at the two tasks agents postpone, writing the listing text and writing the visit report back to the owner, and the voice capture on mobile exists so a property can be created during the visit rather than back at the desk. The assistant also reads the vendor's own documentation and can open the right form or run the action it just described, which is how a new negotiator gets productive without a training session. Agencies that buy the website and search work from the same publisher get lead capture wired into the same base.

tools.name: Prospeneo
tools.positioning: All-in-one French real estate CRM for agencies and mandataire networks, sold as separate applications for prospecting, sale and rental, marketing and websites.
tools.description: Prospeneo is a French real estate CRM published by Facilogi and sold to independent agencies and to networks of mandataires. It is organised as applications rather than one monolith: prospecting, sales and rentals, callback scenarios, automations, email marketing, landing pages, forms, teams and privileges, and analytics. The sale and rental application covers listing creation with AI-assisted copywriting, a media manager, contact records and buyer-to-listing matching with a detailed matching view. A separate website line called Vitrinellis provides agency sites built for lead capture, with search, high-definition photos, video and virtual tours, social sharing, geolocation, moderated customer reviews, a gateway to the transaction software, and embeddable popups, forms, pages and newsletters. Website pricing is published from €69 per month for the Starter subscription and €89 for Essentiel, with a setup fee.
tools.real_estate_use: A mandataire network has a structural problem an agency does not: several hundred independent agents, each with their own listings and contacts, who must be equipped identically and supervised without being employees. Prospeneo answers it with team and privilege management and per-agent analytics sitting on top of the same CRM, and by selling the pieces separately so a solo mandataire and a network head office do not pay for the same thing. In daily use the centre of gravity is matching: a new listing arrives, the software proposes which registered buyers fit it, and the callback scenarios make sure none of them is forgotten for three weeks. The website line matters because for a mandataire the site is the shopfront, there being no physical one.

tools.name: Respage

tools.description: Respage is a marketing and leasing platform aimed at apartment communities. A leasing CRM, review solicitation, reputation management, resident surveys and an events module sit on the same account.
tools.real_estate_use: A multifamily operator with a dozen communities usually buys a website vendor, an advertising agency, a chatbot and a reputation tool separately, then discovers that none of them share a lead. Respage is the argument for buying that chain from one place: the ad that produced the enquiry, the bot that answered it at ten at night and the CRM that carries it to a signed lease are the same system. The AI leasing piece is the part that decides the purchase for most teams — prospect volume arrives outside office hours and a leasing office of two people cannot answer it. Marketing agencies serving multifamily are the competition, not other software.

tools.name: Tenant Turner
tools.positioning: Leasing automation for US property managers: syndicate the listing, pre-qualify the lead, let the prospect book a showing and open the door themselves.
tools.description: Tenant Turner automates the leasing cycle between a vacant unit and a signed lease. It imports listings from the property management system and pushes them to more than twenty listing sites, applies the manager's own pre-qualification criteria before a prospect can book, and offers either in-person showings or self-showings through electronic lockboxes and smart locks. Prospects self-schedule around the clock; reminders, cancellation of unconfirmed appointments, post-showing feedback collection and application dispatch run automatically. The Ultra plan adds a live answering service for leasing calls. Reporting covers lead flow, showing activity, lockbox use and owner-facing performance.
tools.real_estate_use: Vacancy costs a US property manager more than almost anything else in the operating budget, and the bottleneck is rarely demand — it is the coordination. Someone has to answer the phone, decide whether the caller meets the income and pet rules, agree a time, and physically be at the property. Tenant Turner removes all four steps: the pre-qualification questions gate the calendar, the prospect books at any hour, and a lockbox or smart lock grants access without a staff member driving across town. The manager sees which listings produce leads and which produce no-shows, and hands the owner a report that explains a slow lease-up with numbers. It sits alongside the property management system rather than replacing it, which is why it shows up in the integration directories of the major platforms.
